footer.intro: Checked on {checkedOn} against the latest releases, each in its default quick-start setup ([probes and raw results](https://github.com/DaanRosendal/limmat/blob/master/benchmarks/compare/README.md)). Open an issue or pull request if something is wrong or out of date.
metrics: Rules: safe means no script ran and no unsafe link scheme (such as `javascript:`) was kept. The raw-markers row shows a check for none, a warning for 1 to 3 leaked constructs, and a cross for more. CommonMark scores compare tag structure and text on all {cmTotal} examples of spec 0.31.2, so they are approximate. A check is over 80 percent, a warning 50 to 80, and a cross below. Dependencies are all packages installed below the library, not counting React. Bold marks a release more than a year old.

details.markersNote: TanStack Markdown parses the whole text again on every update.
details.limmatImages: limmat can turn this off with `images: false`.
details.baselinesNote: react-markdown and marked are not built for streaming: each write parses the whole text again, as their documentation shows. They are here because they are the most used.
details.frameworkNote: (Preact runs the React one through `preact/compat`) and works with any other page through the DOM.

markersNotes.streamdown: Streamdown's leaks are brief: a lone opening marker, a half-typed table, or a link's brackets. They appear with its `remend` option on, as in its README.
